summary: Frontend-only end-to-end test of bank statement import (Banco BPM) on QA Azienda Srl / Conto BPM QA (account bf0470c3-2c87-452b-ad83-99126d5b08ce). I logged in through the UI as the owner, with the TOTP code computed by pyotp. All requested flows PASS. (1) PDF preview: 5 rows with full descriptions. Row 0 matches the expected text exactly. The 'I conti tornano' notice shows, import-balance-after is 12.516,75 €, and the button reads 'Importa 5 movimenti'. After import: toast '5 movimenti importati', the account row and the 'Saldo conti' stat show 12.516,75 €, and the 'Caricamenti' button appears. (2) XLS (HTML-disguised .xls) preview: 'Excel (.xls)' badge, 2 rows, '1 possibili doppioni' badge. Row 0 shows 'Simile a un movimento già presente del 20 gen 2026: VERSAMENTO CONTANTI' and import-include-0 is unchecked. Initial state: 'Importa 1 movimenti' / 12.216,25 €. Ticked: 'Importa 2 movimenti' / 13.196,25 €. Unticked again: back to 1 / 12.216,25 €. After import the account shows 12.216,25 € and 'Movimenti importati fino al 5 feb 2026'. (3) The history modal lists the uploads. Undoing movimenti.xls gives the toast 'Caricamento annullato: 1 movimenti tolti', the balance returns to 12.516,75 € and the row badge reads 'Annullato · 1 movimenti tolti'. (4) The manual balance toggle shows import-balance-input. Note: my first undo script selected the wrong entry (my mistake: the text 'movimenti' also matches the PDF row), so it undid the PDF first. That gave 9.699,50 €, which is correct (12.216,25 − 2.516,75). I then re-imported the PDF (sum mode: 9.699,50 + 2.516,75 = 12.216,25 €, correct) and undid the XLS, ending at 12.516,75 € as expected.

issues: When you re-import an older statement while the account already has later movements (the PDF up to 20/01 after the XLS up to 05/02), the box shows 'I conti tornano' AND the orange warning 'Il saldo finale scritto nel file è 12.516,75 €: differenza di 300,50 €'. The computed balance (12.216,25 €) is correct: the 300,50 € is the later F24 debit. The warning is therefore misleading. Suggestion: compare the file's closing balance with the account balance at closing_balance_date, or skip the warning when there are account movements after the file's end date.
The balance date field ('Alla data', st-bal-date) and ManualAccountModal use the browser's native date picker (input type=date), not the shadcn calendar.

The import toast reads '1 movimenti importati, 1 già presenti' even though the skipped row was a possible duplicate the user chose not to import, not an exact duplicate. Consider 'non importati' / 'doppioni saltati'.

Italian singular/plural: '1 movimenti importati', 'Importa 1 movimenti', '1 movimenti tolti', '1 possibili doppioni', '1 movimenti hanno lo stesso importo'. Should be '1 movimento' / '1 possibile doppione'.

Modal titles 'Importa estratto conto · Banco BPM IBAN non indicato' and 'Caricamenti · Banco BPM IBAN non indicato' have no separator between the bank name and the masked IBAN. The account label ('Conto BPM QA') is also missing.

After an import the row still says 'saldo al 16 nov 2026' (today), while the movements only go up to 20 gen / 5 feb 2026. This may be intended, but the balance date could reflect the statement's closing date.

action_items: Optional: avoid the 'differenza di X €' warning when the account has movements after the file's end date (the warning is misleading in the re-import case).
Optional: Italian singular forms for count 1 in toasts, buttons and badges.
Optional: wording of the 'già presenti' toast when similar rows are skipped.
critical_code_review_comments: BankImport.js BalanceBox: the 'differs' check compares preview.closing_balance_cents (the balance at the file's date) with 'after' (the current balance after import, which includes later movements). This mixes two different points in time.

BankImport.js toImport = preview.new_count + include.size assumes every included index is a 'similar' row. That holds today because only similar rows render a checkbox, but it would break if include ever held duplicates.
BankImport.js is 462 lines, which is fine. It holds 3 modals plus helpers; consider splitting if it grows.

The balance is 12.516,75 €. The account no longer has 'no imports'.
